1479-3147-8293.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it, Cleveland Booker, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Cleveland Booker trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2364-5660-6769-6797.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2364-5660-6769-6797.description:

When Mana Vault enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Mana Vault, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mana Vault from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.

Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.

Resolve the Accursed Centaur trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Accursed Centaur.
When the token Accursed Centaur enters, it triggers, sacrificing Rot Hulk.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger from step 2, creating a token copy of Rot Hulk.
When the token Rot Hulk enters, it triggers, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

225-1170-6984-7529.description:

When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Studious First-Year, which enters prepared.
Resolve Rampant Growth, fetching a basic land from your library to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Reveillark.

Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Rhys from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Rhys enters, it triggers, giving Reveillark persist until end of turn.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate a Shard by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage using Meneldor. It triggers, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
At the beginning of the next end step, Timestream Navigator is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

Cyclical Evolution triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Murmuring Mystic triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Cyclical Evolution.
Repeat.
1618-2440-3992-4146.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Murmuring Mystic. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Solid Ground.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
4968-6593-7061.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar if desired.

Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.

5478-5702-5954-6441.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.

Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two untapped Everywhere land tokens due to Spelunking.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Orcish Bowmasters and the Orc Army, adding {1}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
Saruman triggers, creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat from step 5.

Resolve the Felhide Spiritbinder trigger, causing you to pay {1}{R} to create a token copy of Priest of Urabrask with haste.

Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Othelm.
Repeat.
